主要内容: On March 4, 2014, Broadway Financial Corporation announced that the holders of the senior securities of the trust holding its Floating Rate Junior Subordinated Debentures due March 17, 2014 approved an extension of the Debentures' maturity to March 17, 2024. The proposal included paying all accrued interest through the modification of the indenture, plus up to $900,000 or 15% of the principal amount at face value. The extension is conditional on raising at least $6 million in new equity capital and obtaining approvals from regulators and senior lenders. The press release is attached as Exhibit 99.1 to this report on Form 8-K.
